method: Original-master-equation two-horizon Jost Frobenius series plus dense DOP853 integration, using independently checked fixed frequencies and no spectral eigenvectors.
factoring: Phi=psi/[t^p_h(1-t)^p_c], p_h,p_c the physical radiation Frobenius powers; this differs from factoring (1+y),(1-y) only by a constant removed by normalization.
normalization: Phi(y=-.3)=1, performed by direct reference evaluation, not interpolation.
scope: Binary64 numerical references, with two endpoint offsets and series orders. Configuration difference is a practical consistency diagnostic, not a rigorous error bound; fixed-frequency uncertainty remains.
norm_definitions: Absolute Linf is max_j abs(Phi_a-Phi_b). Relative Linf divides this by max_j abs(Phi_b), configuration_b. The legacy fields reference_configuration_difference_Linf and nested eigenfunction_error_to_independent_Frobenius_Linf retain ABSOLUTE values; use the explicit absolute/relative fields.
